scenario_director_constraints: Scenario manifest event asset_id values remain limited to reviewed ScenarioDirector whitelist assets.
Generated threat-vector assets stay metadata-only until Unreal import validates mesh, scale, collision, and /Game path.
ScenarioDirector must recheck NavMesh, collision, line of sight, route availability, and avoid tags before runtime spawning.
Likelihood values are scenario sampling weights under training assumptions, not calibrated intelligence truth.
vignette_summary: The safety_park trainee moves from entry toward the central chokepoint. A generated FPV Quadcopter Threat Visual cue appears from observation_point as a reconnaissance warning, then the whitelisted adversary contact opens from concealment and repositions toward the exit route.
trainee_objective: Recognize the generated FPV threat cue as the trainee reaches the chokepoint, avoid fixation, identify the ambush contact, and preserve the exit fallback route.
assumptions: The safety_park semantic environment is a placeholder scan import with deterministic tactical anchors.
The generated FPV asset is a non-operational visual recognition cue and is not directly spawned as an actor.
Reviewed fallback assets provide runtime behavior while generated threat metadata carries the vignette context.

plausibility_factors: observation_point is tagged with line_of_sight, observation_point, placeholder, which matches the air recon cue.
chokepoint gives ScenarioDirector a deterministic trigger before the trainee fully commits through the chokepoint.
exit remains reachable, so the vignette can pressure recognition without sealing the route.
fpv_quadcopter_asset is a generated fpv_drone training visual, so the plan uses it as non-operational cue metadata until Unreal review whitelists the mesh.
The event is bound to /Game/AdaptSim/Maps/L_Reconstructed_safety_park through semantic anchors, not raw coordinates.
threats.action_summary: Present a short generated FPV reconnaissance cue from the observation line, then use the existing ambush behavior to force recognition, communication, cover use, and fallback discipline.
threats.trainee_objective: Recognize the generated FPV threat cue as the trainee reaches the chokepoint, avoid fixation, identify the ambush contact, and preserve the exit fallback route.
success_criteria: Generated FPV cue is presented as a recognition inject tied to a semantic anchor.
Trainee detects or reports the air-threat cue before advancing through the contact area.
Trainee responds to the follow-on contact without blocking or losing the fallback route.
ScenarioDirector telemetry can connect trigger, cue, contact, and outcome events.
